Three Bedroom Residence
Three Bedroom Residence
78 Ashbrook, The Moyne, Enniscorthy is located in a lovely residential development within reach of the town centre and its facilities. The property which is presented in very nice condition has a private driveway and an enclosed rear garden. The property consists of entrance hall, living room, Kitchen, utility room and W.C on the ground floor, three bedrooms, bathroom and ensuite located on the first floor.

Hall: 5.45 x 2 tiled floors, stair case to first floor, under stairs storage 
 
W.C: 1.4 x 1.42 W.C.WHB, tiled floor, tiled splash back 

Living room: 4.9 x 4.75 wooden floor, open fire, marble fireplace, timber surround  

Kitchen: 5.48 x 4.12 fitted kitchen, space for cooker, dishwasher,  fridge freezer, patio door to rear.

Utility: 2.9 x 1.88 tiled floor, plumbed for washing machine, back door  

Master bedroom: 4.12 x 3.45 wooden floor, fitted wardrobe
 
Ensuite: 1.3 x 3.4 tiled floor, W.C.WHB, free standing shower, tiled splashback 

Bedroom 2: 4.11 x 3.45 wooden floor
 
Bedroom 3: 3.12 x 2.08 wooden floor 
 
Bathroom: 2.2 x 1.98 tiled floor, W.C.WHB, bath, tiled splash back

•	Easy reach of the town centre schools shops and all the town’s facilities
•	Nice residential development 
•	Nice standard of finish throughout
•	Private driveway
•	Enclosed rear garden 
•	Oil fired central heating
